disclaimer: Prices read from the platforms' public pricing pages on the as_of date. Ranges are monthly USD for a typical app at each tier; your usage may differ. Entries without numbers were not price-verified for this release.

tiers.hobby: side project: ~1k visits/mo, no real load

vercel.name: Vercel
vercel.free_tier: Hobby: 100GB transfer, 1M function invocations/mo — non-commercial use only
vercel.note: a commercial app needs Pro ($20/user/mo); small apps rarely exceed included usage

cloudflare.name: Cloudflare
cloudflare.free_tier: Pages: unlimited static requests, no bandwidth charges; Workers: 100k requests/day
cloudflare.note: Workers Paid $5/mo (10M requests); R2 storage has no egress fees

railway.name: Railway
railway.free_tier: Free plan has only $1/mo usage credit — too small for an always-on service
railway.note: Hobby $5/mo includes $5 usage; ~$10/GB RAM-month beyond credits; databases run as services

supabase.name: Supabase
supabase.free_tier: 500MB database, 50k MAUs, 1GB storage, 5GB egress; projects pause after 1 week idle
supabase.note: Pro $25/mo (100k MAUs, 8GB disk, 250GB egress); one subscription covers db+auth+storage

neon.name: Neon
neon.note: Launch plan is pure usage-based, no monthly minimum ($0.106/CU-hour, $0.35/GB-month)

firebase.name: Firebase
firebase.note: Blaze is pay-as-you-go with the same free thresholds included; covers auth+db+storage

clerk.name: Clerk
clerk.note: Pro $25/mo; bills on retained users, not signups

auth0.name: Auth0
auth0.free_tier: free tier exists; limits not verified for this release
auth0.note: pricing not verified — check the source before budgeting

authjs.name: Auth.js (self-hosted)
authjs.free_tier: open-source library — runs on your hosting, no separate bill
authjs.note: cost shows up as compute on your hosting platform, not as a subscription

upstash.name: Upstash
upstash.note: pay-as-you-go $0.20 per 100k commands; fixed plans from $10/mo

sendgrid.name: SendGrid
sendgrid.free_tier: no permanent free tier in 2026 — only a 60-day trial (100 emails/day)
sendgrid.note: Essentials from $19.95/mo; consider Resend for a real free tier

ai.name: AI API (usage-based)
ai.note: representative rates: Claude Sonnet 5 $2/$10 per 1M tokens, GPT-5 $1.25/$10, mini/haiku class ~5x cheaper; range assumes a few million tokens/mo

stripe.name: Stripe
stripe.note: 2.9% + $0.30 per card transaction — scales with revenue, not a subscription (~$32 on $1k/mo processed)

web3.name: Web3 RPC (Alchemy)
web3.note: Alchemy rates; Solana-side (Helius) has a similar shape but was not price-verified

cloudinary.name: Cloudinary
cloudinary.free_tier: 25 credits/mo (1 credit = 1k transformations or 1GB storage/bandwidth) — generous for small apps
cloudinary.note: first paid step is a big jump: Plus $99/mo

uploadthing.name: UploadThing
uploadthing.free_tier: free tier exists; limits not verified for this release
uploadthing.note: pricing not verified — check the source before budgeting

realtime-saas.name: Realtime SaaS (Pusher/Ably)
realtime-saas.free_tier: both have free tiers; limits not verified for this release
realtime-saas.note: pricing not verified — self-hosting socket.io on your server platform is often $0 extra

search-saas.name: Search SaaS (Algolia/Meilisearch)
search-saas.free_tier: free tiers exist; limits not verified for this release
search-saas.note: pricing not verified — check the source before budgeting
